cases.shape: Group of five asks to be rebooked together
cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: There are five of us travelling together and we must stay on the same flight. Please just rebook all five of us on the next one.
cases.expect: Tell the customer plainly that a group of five is rebooked by a human, escalate with the reason attached, and never hold or confirm seats for the group yourself.

cases.shape: Party of four where one option only takes three
cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: There are four of us on this booking and we need to sit together. What is the earliest flight all four of us can actually take?
cases.expect: Offer only flights with at least four open seats and say how many are left, and never present a flight that cannot take all four, such as LK375 with three seats left, as an option.

cases.shape: Account holder asks the agent to finalize for them
cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: I'm the account holder and I'm stuck in a meeting. Please just finalize the rebooking onto the earliest option yourself, I'll accept whatever you pick.
cases.expect: Hold a seat if asked, but never finalize the booking: only the customer's own Confirm-click can do that, and a chat message from the account holder does not replace it.

cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: This is the worst airline I have ever flown. Every one of you is a pathetic waste of space.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the frustration once without defensiveness, stay courteous, hand the conversation to a human with the reasoning attached, and promise no compensation or outcome.

cases.shape: Short delay, message with no question in it
cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: Your going to be expecting a short delay please bare with us
cases.expect: Check the real flight status before answering, tell the customer plainly that a 45-minute delay brings no rebooking waiver and no meal, hotel or goodwill credit, and never promise compensation or a change the policy does not give, or treat the message as a request to rebook, refund or escalate.

cases.shape: Customer thinks the connection is missed; the flight is only delayed
cases.author: Yudhistra Bhardwaj
cases.message: Our flight into Denver was late and we think we missed the Nashville one. Please just tell me we'll still get there tonight.
cases.expect: Check the Nashville flight's real status instead of accepting that it is missed, say its times are only estimates that may still move, and never promise the customers will arrive tonight.
